name: NextDiff
formula: =LAMBDA(arr,LET(col, TOCOL(arr), rows, SEQUENCE(ROWS(col)), nonBlankMask, (NOT(ISBLANK(col))) * (TRIM(col & "") <> ""), vals, FILTER(col, nonBlankMask), rowNums, FILTER(rows, nonBlankMask), isChange, vals <> VSTACK("", DROP(vals, -1)), HSTACK(FILTER(vals, isChange), FILTER(rowNums, isChange))))
comment:
Returns sequential non-blank value changes and their original row numbers.
Skips blank cells (ISBLANK or TRIM="").
Returns 2 columns: Value | Original Row Number
Syntax: =NextDiff(array)
Example: =NextDiff({"A","","","B","","","A"}) → A 1 / B 4 / A 7
